welcome.title: Your home for beach volleyball —
paragraphs: Your home for beach volleyball news, weekly broadcasts, athlete interviews, tournament highlights and inspiring stories from Australia and around the world.
We go beyond the game to celebrate the athletes, people and communities that make our sport special.

purpose.title: More than
paragraphs: We believe in the power of sport to bring people together, inspire positive change and build stronger communities.
Through storytelling, media, events and community initiatives, our mission is to uplift, serve and support others.
purpose.involvedText: Become a reporter, volunteer, contributor or collaborator. Whether you’re an athlete, creator, business or sporting enthusiast, there’s a place for you in our community.
purpose.joinText: Chat with players, find a game and hear about events first.

partner.title: Let’s make a difference
partner.text: Beach Volleyball TV welcomes partnerships with businesses, brands, sporting organisations and individuals who share our passion for sport, community and positive change.
partner.note: We are currently running a 10-week podcast at the Budgy Smuggler store in Bondi, with a beach volleyball community day and gala night coming 12 December.

connect.text: For media enquiries, interviews, event coverage, sponsorships, bookings and collaborations, we’d love to hear from you.
